title: Trading
description: Market structure, order books, and the intuition behind market making and arbitrage. Includes weekly mock-trading games and a semester-long paper-trading challenge.

title: Dev
description: The software side of quant work: Python and C++ fundamentals, working with market data, backtesting frameworks, and writing code that other people can read.

title: Math
description: Probability, statistics, linear algebra, and the classic brainteasers that show up in quant interviews, taught through problem sets and group sessions.

title: Hardware
description: An introduction to low-latency systems: FPGAs, networking, and why nanoseconds matter. Hands-on labs with real development boards.
